PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Library.Name: Predator Tactics
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Library.Description: Predator-themed pursuit, ambush, pack-hunting, positioning, and finishing abilities.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.AmbushRush.Name: Ambush Rush
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.AmbushRush.Desc: Requirements The creature is hidden or undetected by the target. The creature Strides up to twice its Speed, then makes a melee Strike against the target. The target is off-guard against this Strike.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.DragDown.Name: Drag Down
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.DragDown.Descri: The creature makes a melee Strike. If it hits and deals damage, it can then attempt an Athletics check to Trip the same target without needing a free hand. The Strike and Trip both count toward the creature's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty does not increase until after this activity is complete.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.Hamstring.Name: Hamstring
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.Hamstring.Descr: The creature makes a melee Strike aimed at a leg, wing, or other means of locomotion. On a hit, the target takes a 10-foot penalty to its Speed until the end of its next turn.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.BloodScent.Name: Blood Scent
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.BloodScent.Desc: The creature has imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet, but only for living creatures that are below their maximum Hit Points. It can also use this sense to Seek injured prey or follow its trail.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.WoundedQuarry.D: The creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against creatures at or below half their maximum Hit Points.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.CirclingPredato: The creature circles for a better angle, briefly increasing its mobility as it probes the prey's defenses.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.IsolationHunter: The creature instinctively singles out prey that has become separated from allies and exploits that isolation.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.PackCollapse.De: The creature coordinates with nearby hunters to close every escape route, leaving pressured prey off-guard when the maneuver succeeds.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.FlankAndFade.De: When an ally creates an opening, the creature slips to a new position before the prey can properly respond.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.RelentlessPursu: When its prey tries to escape, the creature immediately gives chase and keeps the distance from opening.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.CorneredFury.De: The creature lashes out when threatened prey attempts to break away, turning retreat into another dangerous moment.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.LatchingBite.De: The creature clamps onto its prey with jaws, claws, coils, or another natural hold. It attempts an Athletics check against the target's Fortitude DC; on a success, it keeps the prey close as described by the ability.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.RakeTheFallen.D: The creature punishes prey that has fallen prone, striking before the target can recover its footing.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.CullTheWeak.Des: The creature recognizes hesitation, injury, and impaired defenses, focusing its most vicious attacks on compromised prey.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.SuddenBurst.Des: Once per encounter, the creature explodes into motion with a short burst of speed that does not consume its normal rhythm of attacks.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.StalkersPatienc: The creature is willing to wait motionless for the right opening, favoring a decisive first attack over a premature charge.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.ShadowTheQuarry: When the quarry shifts position, the creature silently adjusts its own approach to remain difficult to shake.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.TerritorialChal: The creature issues a threatening cry, posture, or display. One creature within 30 feet that can perceive the threat attempts a Will save against the hunter's high creature DC. On a failure, the target becomes frightened 1.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.HerdThePrey.Des: The creature surges through nearby prey and forces them away from safe positions. Creatures in a 15-foot cone attempt a Reflex save against the hunter's high creature DC. On a failure, their land Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.BoundingReposit: The creature leaps, darts, or scrambles to a nearby angle, using terrain and body movement to reposition without losing pressure.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.PredatorsExchan: The creature and an ally trade pressure on the same prey, allowing the creature to shift position when the other hunter attacks.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.CrushingGrip.De: Requirement: The creature already has the target in its grasp. It attempts an Athletics check against the target's Fortitude DC. On a success, it tightens the hold with punishing force and the target becomes enfeebled 1.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.FinishTheHunt.D: The creature commits fully to a wounded target, making a deliberate finishing assault against prey already showing signs of defeat.
When an enemy overextends or badly misses, the creature immediately turns that mistake into a change of position or counterattack.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.ApexInstinct.De: The creature reads the battlefield as hunting ground, quickly identifying vulnerable prey and likely escape routes when combat begins.
